name: BITEZ Gummies 10,000MG Jarz - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Sour Apple Grape
description: Enjoy sweet n’ sour with Double-Stacked Sour Apple Grape BITEZ. Two bold layers combine crisp, tart green apple with rich, tangy grape for a sweet-and-sour flavor that brings plenty of pucker with every chewy bite. Each double-stacked gummy packs a powerful 1,000mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend (10 gummies per jar, 10,000mg total). A heavy-hitting combination of sour fruit flavor and serious potency.
